summary: This Aurora Technological Solutions policy note sets out the company's health paradigm, which treats employee mental health as the foundation of productivity and innovation. It describes counseling services, a stigma-free culture of openness, preventive education, and new success metrics that include workforce wellness. It closes by inviting employees to join a collective pursuit of well-being.
one_line: Aurora Technological Solutions' policy making employee mental health a core performance indicator, backed by counseling, preventive education and a stigma-free culture.
key_facts: Aurora Technological Solutions treats employees as whole beings whose mental health is crucial to communal and corporate success.
The company frames mental health as the 'unseen bedrock of performance' and is reshaping policy to make mental health support its keystone for productivity.
Promoting mental health is described as both an ethical and a strategic decision.
Aurora offers a suite of counseling services and mental health support designed to preemptively address stress, anxiety, and depression.
The company is working to remove the stigma around mental health and encourages open conversations and vulnerability to build trust and understanding.
Counseling access ranges from in-house professionals to confidential virtual appointments, integrated into employees' daily lives.
Preventive measures include regular workshops, seminars, and health challenges aimed at building resilience, promoting worklife balance, and educating staff on mental health maintenance.
Aurora commits to continuous investment in education and preventive measures against mental health decline.
Key Performance Indicators at Aurora now encompass the wellness of the workforce, alongside technical milestones.
The policy states that employee health is inextricably linked to the health of the company.
The company invites employees to join a collective pursuit of comprehensive well-being.
The note ties the company name 'Aurora' to the image of dawn breaking on a new mode of accessibility for mental health resources.

entities.name: Aurora Technological Solutions
entities.role: Company issuing the mental health and well-being policy and redefining productivity metrics
